claims.subject: GAMEPLAN+0x2 data type and RVA 0x146ec50 ABI
claims.raw_disassembly: 0x146ec59: movzx ecx, word ptr [rcx + 2]; call 0x140f40eb0; xor edx, edx; mov rcx, rax; call 0x1409cd2a0; mov rdx, rax; mov rcx, rbx; jmp 0x14146eaa0
claims.verdict: GAMEPLAN+0x2 is strictly a uint16 owner_team_index. 0x146ec50 converts it to TEAM* via 0x140f40eb0, then gets CoachData* via 0x1409cd2a0, and tail-calls 0x146eaa0. The previous GREA-01 shorthand 'mov rcx, [rcx+2]' was textually imprecise and is WITHDRAWN; no data type conflict exists.
claims.counter_evidence: Instruction is movzx ecx, word ptr [rcx + 2], not a 64-bit pointer load.

claims.subject: RVA 0x131f110 commit scope
claims.raw_disassembly: 0x131f11a: test byte ptr [rcx + 0x7bc4], 1; je 0x131f13d; add rcx, 0x7854; call 0x1414f7ec0; lea rcx, [rbx + 0x7854]; call 0x14146ec80; and dword ptr [rbx + 0x7bc4], ~1
claims.verdict: 0x131f110 only flushes the DEFAULT gameplan at offset +0x7854 (Slot 35). It does NOT loop over or commit individual opponent gameplans (+0x4 to +0x7850). Opponent gameplans rely on IsInUse=1 set at 0x7a7aab and season-level serialization.
claims.counter_evidence: Hardcoded offset 0x7854 used in lea/add instructions; zero iteration over opponent slots.

claims.subject: Manager 35 slots of 880 bytes layout

claims.verdict: Capacity is strictly 0x23 (35 slots), stride is strictly 0x370 (880 bytes), base offset is +4. Opponent team index is at slot +0x4 (0xfe12f0: movzx ecx, word ptr [rcx + 4]). Roster slots are 23 entries of stride 4 starting at slot +0x6 (0x146e780).
